messages:
release-eng: Quick heads-up — embeddings service is seeing sporadic OOMs in the quant path (~5-10% of requests). I have a hotfix image ready (hotfix-20260321-1) that pins serializer and forces the safe fallback. Targeting a short window in ~25m. Requesting expedited approvals to do a staged rollout (20% -> 50% -> 100%) and skip the long canary since this is causing user-facing errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/482

maria-oncall: Oncall: I can approve watching the rollout. Need a rollback plan and that ops is standing by.

sanjay: Product: we need PM signoff for the fallback behavior (latency trade-off). cc @tess-pm

tess-pm: Product approves. Higher latency OK vs OOMs. Please add a short release-note blurb and notify support.

devex-mike: DevEx: will patch release notes + console blurb. +1 from docs.

ops-lead: Ops: Approve assuming deploy-bot can do staged routing and we have a pinned rollback image. Who has the image tag and rollback tag?

release-eng: Image tags: deploy image = ghcr.io/redwood/embed-service:hotfix-20260321-1. Rollback image = ghcr.io/redwood/embed-service:hotfix-rollback-20260320. Config change is a small flag flip + new imagemag.

release-eng: @deploy-bot please start rollout to eu-west1 first at 20% (staged: 20,50,100). Monitor 10m between ramps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout for embeddings-service -> image hotfix-20260321-1; regions: eu-west1 (first), us-central (after). stages: 20,50,100. monitor_window=10m. command: `/deploy embeddings --image hotfix-20260321-1 --stages 20,50,100 --monitor 10m`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: eu-west1 canary 20% started. instances updating: 3/15. health checks passing on updated instances. Telemetry (canary) shows error rate down ~60%.

maria-oncall: seeing p95 latency bump on canary +35ms. Is that within expected?

tess-pm: acceptable given error improvement. keep an eye on user-facing graphs.

devex-mike: noted, adding latency note to release entry.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoting eu-west1 to 50% now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: eu-west1 50% complete. health ok, no further OOMs observed in canary. Ready to go to 100% in eu-west1 on ops thumbs-up.

ops-lead: :thumbsup: proceed to 100% in eu-west1. Hold us-central until we confirm regional behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling eu-west1 to 100% now. will start us-central 20% in ~15m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: eu-west1 100% done. starting us-central canary at 20%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: us-central canary is failing — 2/4 updated instances OOM with `runtime: out of memory` in logs. initiating automatic rollback for us-central canary.

release-eng: Rollback us-central canary and hold further promotion. Keep eu-west1 at new image. We'll investigate batch-size distribution differences.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete in us-central -> image hotfix-rollback-20260320. eu-west1 remains at hotfix-20260321-1 (100%).

sanjay: I'll throttle ingress to us-central and kick off a deeper repro. If it persists I'll open an incident and collect heap traces.

maria-oncall: Monitoring. For now we keep eu-west1 live and do not promote anywhere else. Ops: any config differences between regions we should check?

ops-lead: configs look identical. my hunch: request batch-size / seq-length distribution differs by region, triggering the quant path OOM. I'll run a targeted canary in us-central with reduced batch size after a quick fix.

release-eng: Sounds good. I'll prepare a follow-up hotfix that adjusts batch config and push a candidate image. For now: expedited approvals granted (product, oncall, ops). Marking this as partial rollout: eu-west1 deployed, us-central rolled back. Updating release notes and support thread.

tess-pm: Please add this to release notes: 'Partial rollout: eu-west1 deployed successful; us-central temporarily rolled back pending config tweak. No user-facing data loss expected.'

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release notes updated: https://confluence.redwood/releases/embed-hotfix-20260321 (note added). Closing actions assigned to release-eng and ops-lead.

devex-mike: I'll add a Console alert for quant OOM count and a short log snippet so SREs can quickly triage.

maria-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll stay on watch for the next 2 hours and escalate if anything spikes.

sanjay: Opening follow-up PR for batch-size change: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/485. Will run small canary in us-central after CI passes.

release-eng: Thanks all — expedited approvals collected. We'll reconvene in the PR thread once the batch patch is validated. Closing this thread once owners ack.

ops-lead: ack.

maria-oncall: ack.

release-eng: closing thread — leaving notes for postmortem if we need one after the follow-up canary.
